purpose: Make the REX ledger an active reusable checklist for recurring and persistent problems before and after every measured task.

recurrence_levels.NEW: first observed occurrence; bind event and immediate disposition
recurrence_levels.RECURRING: same REX on >=2 distinct task_id or run_id; add or strengthen automated prevention/checklist
recurrence_levels.PERSISTENT: same REX on >=3 distinct tasks or >=2 distinct missions, or recurrence after an accepted preventive control; force architecture/resource/role review
recurrence_levels.REGRESSION: reappears after CONTROL/closure; reopen REX, block relevant CONTROL claim and create first-red action

before_task: mission_id task_id assignment_id crew_id and state use registered namespaces
entity action status and lifecycle state are not overloaded
new namespace has a declared owner
if_triggered: STOP semantic promotion
route to Architect/Cartographer/REX
repair registry or state machine before adding automation

before_task: new mission task role evidence and status terms are registered or explicitly provisional
KEB mapping exists for synonyms/aliases
if_triggered: DEFER semantic claim
register or map vocabulary
bind exact source/definition
proof_of_prevention: no unregistered term in emitted receipt

checklist.problem: YAML line length / recurring formatting CI defect
before_task: changed YAML is linted before merge
generated YAML obeys bounded formatting rules
if_triggered: repair generator or lint rule instead of repeated manual patch
record recurrence against builder/generator surface

before_task: active assignment is current for this mission
returned/retired actions are not dispatched
temporal lineage identifies superseded surfaces
if_triggered: RETURN or RETIRE stale action
repair active registry
do not count stale queue as current load

before_task: victory condition and DoV are named
evidence owner/challenger is named
exact-SHA receipt path is defined
promotion authority is explicit and bounded
if_triggered: WITHHOLD promotion
bind missing proof gate
require independent or merged-head repeat where applicable

before_task: workflow existence is not treated as runtime evidence
runner/job telemetry will capture actual execution
if_triggered: route to Dockmaster/runtime lane
do not patch application code before runner assignment unless separate evidence justifies it
withhold runtime competency credit
proof_of_prevention: runtime receipt bound to exact SHA

checklist.problem: CRLF bytes from Windows text writers drift pinned blob OIDs
before_task: every new text writer passes newline="\n" and encoding="utf-8"
git ls-files --eol shows i/lf w/lf for touched files
if_triggered: strip CR from the written files
rewrite the writer with newline="\n"
regenerate pinned outputs (REX-008)
proof_of_prevention: JADE QA portability PASS on the exact head

checklist.problem: pinned generated outputs stale after a pinned-source change
before_task: is the changed file a DAG/launcher input (regen.py --list)?
source change committed before regeneration
if_triggered: python mission-control/jade_temple/tools/regen.py --write
commit the regenerated outputs as their own commit
proof_of_prevention: Launcher outputs current and tests PASS on the exact head

checklist.problem: second session on a live PR branch duplicates the fix
before_task: git fetch origin <branch> and compare with the PR headRefOid
Invoke-DraftPrPass.ps1 does not class the PR as LIVE
if_triggered: stop editing; drop the duplicate commits
verify the other session's fix covers the finding
correct any reply that cites an unpushed SHA
proof_of_prevention: one fixing commit per finding on the PR

checklist.problem: addressed bot review threads left unresolved keep first-pass-closure red
before_task: list unresolved threads with priority, author and outdated flag (Invoke-DraftPrPass.ps1 -ShowThreads)
if_triggered: verify each thread against the head
reply with fixing SHA and file:line, then resolve
fix and push the ones that are not addressed
re-run the pass after Codex re-reviews
proof_of_prevention: 0 unresolved threads on the exact head

checklist.problem: stale GITHUB_TOKEN in an inherited shell returns 401 from gh
before_task: gh calls run with GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN unset or in a stripped child process
if_triggered: unset the variables for that command
run Invoke-WorkspaceAudit.ps1 to find the scope that still sets it
remove it there and restart the parent app
proof_of_prevention: gh api user succeeds with the keyring login
audit token check reports no invalid token

allocation_rules: persistent or regression REX affecting a competency adds reverse pressure against assigning the same unsupported crew/resource pattern
successful preventive-control repeats add positive evidence to the responsible crew competency but never auto-promote a role
PCA features may include REX recurrence and prevention-success counts only when sourced from measured task receipts
BT pairwise outcomes may compare allocation strategies on REX recurrence only for comparable task classes
